STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean module RTL: stage1/design.v
InstructionDescribe the interface, parameters, and observable behavior of this clean design. Return a self-contained specification, not RTL implementation code. A separate isolated call will receive your specification.

Stored wording: stage1/TASK.md

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: stage1/design.v · Open raw
module origen_011852(
    input [5:0] instr_op_i,
    output RegWrite_o,
    output [2:0] ALUOp_o,
    output ALUSrc_o,
    output RegDst_o
);

    // Internal registers
    reg write, src, Dst;
    reg [2:0] op;

    // Instruction op-codes
    parameter OP_RTYPE = 6'b000000;
    parameter OP_ADDI  = 6'b001000;
    parameter OP_LUI   = 6'b001111;

    // Combinational logic block
    always @(instr_op_i) begin
        case(instr_op_i)
            OP_RTYPE: begin
                write = 1'b1;
                op = 3'b010;
                src = 1'b0;
                Dst = 1'b1;
            end
            OP_ADDI: begin
                write = 1'b1;
                op = 3'b110;
                src = 1'b1;
                Dst = 1'b0;
            end
            OP_LUI: begin
                write = 1'b1;
                op = 3'b100;
                src = 1'b1;
                Dst = 1'b0;
            end
            default: begin
                write = 1'b0;
                op = 3'b000;
                src = 1'b0;
                Dst = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Continuous assignments
    assign RegWrite_o = write;
    assign ALUOp_o = op;
    assign ALUSrc_o = src;
    assign RegDst_o = Dst;

endmodule
STAGE 2

Complete the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 text plus masked module rtl: stage2_template/design.v. Required top module: origen_011852.
InstructionRestore the masked expression in design.v using the specification and retained RTL context. Return the complete corrected RTL with the same top module. Only the default configuration is scored.

Stored wording: stage2_template/TASK.md
